summary: Iter 166 frontend-only regression — Video-Guide speed + Guide Studio drafts + event_hints gating. ALL 5 scenarios PASS. Video-Guide loads 12 tiles in ~1.58s with 12/12 posters (naturalWidth=1280) and 12/12 duration badges; sessionStorage cache 'wladbot_guide_clips_v1' populated (5.1KB); reload renders tiles in 0.60s with no skeleton visible. Clip switching updates player script (verified clip start-3-kontext script text updates). Fake call overlay 'Monats-Update-Call' did NOT appear on /dashboard within 95s for standard@wladbot.test nor within 30s for free@wladbot.test. /api/features returns event_hints=false for free, standard, and admin. Admin panel Feature-Rollout row 'Event-Hinweise auf dem Dashboard' shows 'Aus' active (feature-event_hints-off has bg-[#BFFF00] highlight). Guide Studio: script-draft panels exist for start-1-willkommen (119 words, no bullets) and start-2-so-sprichst-du (142 words, no bullets); textarea+approve+save+discard testids present; edit+'Entwurf speichern' persists across reload with no error; clicking 'Film rendern' surfaces 'Skript-Entwurf wartet auf Freigabe — erst freigeben, dann rendern' and does not start a render. Regression: /kurse renders 10 course cards; /dashboard shows next-step-cta and dashboard-more-toggle. No guide-related console errors. Draft was cleaned up (removed appended ' test.') after test — start-1 draft persisted back to original 712-char / 119-word content.

critical_code_review_comments: The stage buttons feature-event_hints-{off,premium,all} indicate active state only via className (bg-[#BFFF00]); no aria-pressed attribute. Adding aria-pressed=true/false would improve accessibility and automated verification of the active stage.

video-guide-player is the container testid; there is no distinct video-guide-active-title / video-guide-script testid, so switching verification relied on scraping 'Zum Lesen' inner text. Adding video-guide-active-title / video-guide-active-script data-testid would make automated diffing more reliable.

On admin dashboard the dashboard-first-tour overlay (z-[9999]) intercepts pointer events for other testids (e.g., action-inbox-toggle) even after localStorage wladbot_onboarding_done=1; the tour still mounts for the standard user. Consider gating the tour render on that flag (not just the CTA).
seed_data_creation: Temporarily appended ' test.' to start-1-willkommen script draft to verify save persistence, then restored to original 119-word text via a second save (verified length back to 712 chars, no 'test.' suffix). No approve/discard performed. event_hints flag was NOT toggled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via POST /api/auth/login {identifier,password} → token → localStorage.wladbot_token (also set wladbot_onboarding_done=1). Direct filling of the /login form was flaky under rate limits; API-token injection worked reliably. Video-Guide sessionStorage cache key is 'wladbot_guide_clips_v1'. Guide Studio testids follow pattern guide-clip-{toggle,card,status,words,script,save,voice,video,publish,render,download}-<slug> and guide-script-draft-{,-text,-approve,-save,-discard}-<slug>. event_hints stage buttons: feature-event_hints-{off,premium,all}; active detected via bg-[#BFFF00] className (no aria-pressed).
